NOT the building with the covered gallery on red posts + second lettering band: that is the west side of Block A north (BLD_A_N lower strip), proven by pano intro2 hotspot 'Library' (A), render 2025 (lettering on A_N west wall) and the orthos (gallery roof strip X 157-161 along A_N; only a shrub strip along B east).
